title: Decision Arena harness: frozen, operator-paid capture of RISE's cases across deciders
acceptance: scripts/arena/arena.mjs capture asks openai (Decisions API), jev, kev, rules and rules-floor the 39 fixed cases through the browser's own request and admitAnswers, keeping raw and admitted decisions; tested with mocked fetch only.

A billed capture refuses under CI, without --bill-operator, from a dirty harness, and before any call if the estimate passes --max-usd (at most 20); at the cap it stops, keeps what was paid for and writes the run marked partial; keys are never written, printed or thrown; tested.

The run is written once (wx) as public/content/arena/run-<sha12>.json with a slim replay-<sha12>.json beside it (run 1 of the 39 cases: admitted decision or reject code per decider; no controls, no raw answers) and index.json, schema syberlabs.decision-arena/v1; scripts/arena/arena-file.mjs refuses an unknown schema, a dirty non-mock harness and a hash/name mismatch; tested. readArenaReplay accepts a replay only as the exact bytes its run file derives; tested.

report re-derives scores (valid, out-of-menu, explicit and contrast agreement raw and admitted, stability of choices, latency, cost per 1k) byte-identically; calibration from #531 per expected question only when the run records calibrationVersion; controls stay sealed until report --reveal-seed-file.
Nothing under src/ imports the harness, and the app and dist/ never name api.openai.com or gpt-6-luna; tested.

evidence.note: node --test scripts/arena/arena.test.mjs: 13/13 pass on branch arena/harness (guards, split probe, refusal, keys never logged, budget, Kev not run, Jev cost, rules, mock run accepted and report byte-identical, src import guard, no OpenAI endpoint in src/public/dist). Mocked fetch only; no paid call.
arena-file moved from src/core/decision to scripts/arena (node:crypto, node:test); nothing in src/ imports it.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: a --mock capture from a clean commit wrote a 3.0 MB run (585 results), readArenaRun accepted it, report printed byte-identical output twice with matchesRecorded true; the mock output was deleted, not committed. Not merged, not deployed, no billed run.

Review fixes: node --test scripts/arena/arena.test.mjs scripts/arena/arena-file.test.mjs: 20 pass, 1 skipped (controls reveal needs #531's controls.mjs); with #531's files present, 37/37 pass including calibration.test.mjs. Both files now run in the CI Fast release checks.

Rebased on main with #531 (ac8a3f9d): calibration imported statically, skip path removed. CI node --test line incl. calibration.test.mjs: 62/62 pass; vitest decision, system-design, cloudflare-headers: 114/114 pass.

Agent run, 2026-10-08: --mock --runs 2 capture wrote a 4.55 MB run (890 results incl. 50 controls) and a 288 KB replay (39 cases, 5 deciders); report printed identical bytes twice with matchesRecorded and matchesReplay true; the replay regenerated byte-identical. Outputs deleted, not committed. Not merged, not deployed, no billed run.
